boardPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / logo-brand, precise-object-edit.
Edit target Image 1: the prior gene-awakening design board. Update it to V2 in the same original compact flat gray pictogram family and warm ivory presentation style.
Reference Image 2: the user's three character states. This is a semantic reference ONLY: ordinary human -> animal-bloodline awakening -> the same awakened animal bloodline plus an additional animal bloodline ability. Do not copy characters, faces, bows, outfits, portraits or card frames into icons.
Reference Image 3: the user's original stat UI screenshot, for the small bloodline panel mock-up. Remove red annotations if displaying the screenshot.
CRITICAL CORRECTION: There are THREE distinct TYPES named exactly "原生", "觉醒", "变异". There are independently FOUR EVOLUTION RANKS named exactly "0阶", "1阶", "2阶", "3阶". Total 12 valid combinations. Awakening is a TYPE, NEVER a rank. Use "进化阶级", never "唤醒等级". Native has human genes; awakened has expressed animal bloodline; mutated preserves that animal bloodline AND gains an additional bloodline ability. Evolution probabilistically changes native to awakened; evolution after awakening can probabilistically change awakened to mutated. Gacha allows direct acquisition, including awakened0 and mutated0. Never imply that 0 means native only, or 3 guarantees mutation.
TYPE SYMBOL DESIGN:
1 原生: preserve the previous plain angular DNA double helix silhouette, two broad intertwined strands and simple ladder gaps, calm compact stable silhouette.
2 觉醒: preserve the same recognizable DNA helix base, transform its TWO TOP ENDS into a conspicuous symmetric pair of pointed outward-sweeping animal-ear / beast-talon tips. Integrate these into the helix itself. A compact abstract animal bloodline crest, not a specific wolf/cat portrait, no eyes or mouth, no outer shield, no frame. Clearly visibly different from the plain helix even at 32px. Only one gene core / helix system.
3 变异: preserve the awakened animal-tip DNA silhouette from 2 EXACTLY, then add a compact SECONDARY bloodline branch growing from its upper-right side with one separate small hollow rhombus gene node connected by a short bent branch. This additional side node signifies an extra animal bloodline ability, not electrical power, not a higher number of rank chevrons. No lightning bolt. It must read as "awakened plus an additional branch", not a completely unrelated emblem. Keep base helix height identical across all 3, secondary node grows laterally within a compact icon footprint. Clear visible gap between extra node and animal tip.
TYPE emblems all monochrome warm graphite gray #706F68, visually substantial 32px pictograms. Flat opaque fill, strong negative space, no shading, glow, gradient, shadows, glossy texture, medical cross, ornate emblem, particles.
EVOLUTION RANKS: preserve the old approved separate rank emblems exactly: 0 = hollow diamond; 1 = one broad solid upward-pointing chevron; 2 = exactly two stacked identical upward chevrons; 3 = exactly three. All same gray, independent of type; no DNA in rank icons. Keep rank count accurate. These four assets remain unchanged except external label wording now uses 阶.
BOARD composition: landscape 1536x1024 approximately. Warm ivory background, clean precise editorial grid, good whitespace, compact Chinese typography. Top title "基因血脉 × 进化". Subtitle exactly "3种类型 + 4个阶级 = 12种组合".
Upper left ~55%: section label "01  血脉类型". Three large emblems in a row with labels "原生" "觉醒" "变异". Small semantic descriptions respectively "人类基因" "动物血脉显现" "叠加额外血脉能力". Make animal tips and secondary branch easy to see.
Upper right ~45%: "02  进化阶级", four large rank marks with labels "0阶" "1阶" "2阶" "3阶".
Lower left ~55%: "03  独立组合". A precise small 3-row by 4-column matrix with column headers "0阶" "1阶" "2阶" "3阶" and row labels "原生" "觉醒" "变异". Each of the 12 cells shows its appropriate TYPE emblem to the left and RANK mark to the right, separated by adequate spacing, no merged glyphs. Same type emblem repeated consistently within each row. Same rank emblem repeated consistently within each column. Especially ensure 觉醒0阶 and 变异0阶 have animal-type symbols AND hollow diamond as separate items.
Lower right ~45%: "04  血脉栏落位". Two small rounded UI panels stacked, directly inspired by the screenshot bloodline card: gray header "血脉", ivory body. First shows awakened animal DNA icon + "觉醒" | hollow diamond rank + "0阶". Second shows mutated animal DNA + second gene-node icon + "变异" | two chevron rank + "2阶". Label below them "类型与阶级分别显示".
Bottom footer line "进化时概率觉醒；觉醒后进化时概率变异". Second concise line "抽卡可直接获得对应类型，觉醒与变异均可从0阶显示".
No word 异变 anywhere: use 变异. No word 级 as the evolution-rank suffix. No colored type rarity, no additional stats or mechanics. This is a revised art-direction board, not production engine screenshot. Render Chinese precisely.
